primitives.name: Temporal Alignment Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Temporal alignment:** play-by-play logs are the primary temporal reference via game-clock timestamps; commentary transcripts and game reports aligned via timestamp matching + textual cues → every video clip linked to its events, commentary, and statistical context.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'time in seconds since game start', 'E(t)': 'event at time t', 'M(t)': 'modal content at time t'}
primitives.assumptions: Events are timestamped with sufficient granularity to resolve intra-frame dynamics; modalities share common temporal anchors.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When inter-modal timestamp mismatch exceeds 0.5s, alignment fails.

layer2.mapping: Maps temporal sequences across modalities to shared identity graph nodes via event-time correspondence.
layer2.telemetry: Alignment accuracy rate across all modalities.

primitives.name: Cross-Modal Entity Resolution Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Cross-modal entity resolution:** references to the same player/team/event linked across modalities into **identity graphs** capturing relationships (teammate, opponent) and attributes (position, statistics, role) —
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'I': 'identity node in graph', 'R(I_i, I_j)': 'relationship between identities i and j', 'A(I)': 'attributes of identity I'}
primitives.assumptions: Entities are uniquely identifiable across modalities; semantic overlap exists between modal representations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When entity ambiguity exceeds 10%, resolution fails.

layer2.mapping: Derives identity graph structure from multimodal input using shared event semantics and attribute consistency checks.
layer2.telemetry: Graph density and clustering coefficient of resolved entities.

primitives.name: LLM-Assisted Instance Generator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **LLM-assisted instance generation:** LLMs synthesize task instances from the assembled multimodal context with task-aware prompt templates → QA pairs, plausible distractors, difficulty-calibrated instances, dense captions, narrative summaries.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'task type', 'P(T)': 'prompt template for task T', 'I(T)': 'generated instance for task T'}
primitives.assumptions: Prompt templates encode task-specific structure; LLMs maintain coherence within generated instances.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When prompt template mismatch exceeds 20%, instance quality degrades.

layer2.mapping: Generates structured task instances by conditioning LLM outputs on multimodal context and task schema.
layer2.telemetry: Instance diversity and task-specific accuracy post-generation.

Cross-modal entity resolution then maps these temporally aligned events into a shared identity graph, where each node represents a unique entity (player, team, event) with associated attributes and relationships. This graph serves as the semantic backbone for higher-level reasoning. The LLM-assisted instance generation leverages this structured context to produce task-specific data, ensuring that synthetic examples reflect real-world complexity.
